question: Where are a hospital positioned within 190 kilometers in the direction of north from Bill Harris Arena, Birmingham, AL?
sql: WITH arena_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bill Harris Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Birmingham%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%AL%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, arena_location AS al WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, al.geometry::geography, 190000) -- 190 kilometers = 190,000 meters AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth(al.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth(al.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 );
